purpose: Teach: 教頭/推し進め/確証/製本/スキャナ/試験場/防火/配色

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、教頭級の指導者からも学べ
lines.en: Ren — learn from leaders at the vice-principal level too.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Light emphasis on 'leaders' — a principle, not a person. Pause after the name. Expectation in the voice, not harshness. The tone of someone who sees potential and is investing in it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究を推し進める仲間を増やします
lines.en: Yes. I'll build up a team of people who can push the research forward.
lines.style: Straightforward, eager to prove understanding. Quick acknowledgment on 'Yes' — not defensive. Slight lean into the commitment. Genuine in the way of someone young trying to be trustworthy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、確証のないデータは論文に載せるな
lines.en: Ren — don't put unverified data into your dissertation.
lines.style: Sharp, clean delivery. The weight lands on 'unverified' and 'don't.' Not lecturing — stating a non-negotiable. Brief. The kind of correction that assumes he'll listen and change.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。博士論文の製本を業者に依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged for a binding service to handle the manuscript printing.
lines.style: Obedient, a touch mechanical. He's heard the correction and moved to logistics immediately — perhaps missing the point slightly. Dutiful but not quite present. Slight flatness in delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のスキャナを使いこなせ
lines.en: Ren — master the lab scanner. You need to know how to use it properly.
lines.style: Firm, practical. The word 'master' lands with quiet insistence. Not warm, but not cold — a requirement stated as a fact of competence. Eyes steady. Brief breath after the name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試験場の予約手続きを確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the reservation procedure for the exam venue.
lines.style: Rapid, dutiful response. He's moved to the next task without pausing — still not catching the underlying point. Slightly breathless. The energy of someone ticking boxes rather than absorbing guidance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の防火点検を欠かすな
lines.en: Ren — don't skip the lab safety inspections. Fire safety is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Serious shift in tone. Heavier. The word 'don't' is firm. A pause before repeating his name. This is no longer about academic excellence — it's about basic responsibility. The exacting boss reading that he hasn't heard yet.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文のグラフの配色を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the color scheme in the dissertation graphs.
lines.style: Rapid acknowledgment, but now with a flicker of awareness that he's missed something. The word 'reviewed' lands soft — he's trying. Still moving fast through tasks, but the breathlessness has a hint of unease underneath. Closing quietly.
